name: Barbarian Fury

features.name: xNudge Roaring Wild
features.description: Nudges until fully visible, +1 multiplier per nudge.

features.name: Barbarian Respin
features.description: Matching barbarians lock for a respin.

review:
Barbarian Fury is a 5x4 slot where a four-row xNudge Roaring Wild sits on reels 2, 3 and 4. It always nudges until fully visible, gaining +1 to its multiplier with each nudge, and several wild multipliers in one win combine.

Three or more matching barbarians can trigger a Barbarian Respin, in which they nudge into full view and lock. Fury Spins make the wild multiplier sticky, so it stops resetting between spins, which is where the 8,785x cap comes into play. Nolimit rates it High volatility, one step below its most extreme games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
